messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

Salvador, your Magic M. 40T on order Shop···· is paid and ships December 14 to (address hidden). The Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA line on that order goes with it. We'll email you the tracking link as soon as it leaves.

You can follow the 40T batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your Harlo L. order, Shop····, is still just the $20 early-bird deposit, so nothing ships on that one yet.

Were you asking about the 40T, or was it the Loto?
Hello Sarah, I was wondering if you have more info on the loto miner? what chips are they using, whats the wattz usage on it, etc
Searched the catalog · Harlo L. miner
Handed to the team · No published Loto spec anywhere I can read; won't guess chips or wattage.

I don't have the Loto's specs yet, Salvador. There's nothing published on the chips, the wattage or the hashrate, and I won't guess, since it's the thing you're deciding on.

I've sent your questions to JD, who handles the hardware. Someone will get back to you with an answer, by email if you've left the chat. If you want it faster, post in our Discord and mention @nullhashrate (that's JD): https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Your $20 deposit holds while you wait.

Sounds good, Salvador. Your 40T still ships December 14, and the Loto specs will come to you once JD has them.

One quick question: when the Loto numbers come in, which one decides it for you, the power draw or the hashrate?
You're welcome, Salvador. The Loto specs will come to your email once JD has them, and your 40T is still on for December 14. Have a good afternoon.
